title: Fire-System Inspection Follow-Ups: Route Deficiency Records to Approved Remedial Work
summary: Turn inspection findings into owned commercial follow-ups while preserving technical review and customer authorization.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


An inspection-follow-up workflow can connect a documented fire-system finding to a service-review task, proposed remedial scope, customer approval and the resulting work order. Preserve the original inspection evidence and the equipment or site reference. The workflow coordinates administrative follow-up; it must not diagnose the condition, decide compliance, or certify remediation. Qualified personnel determine technical requirements, and the authorized customer or commercial owner approves the work before it becomes an execution commitment.


Explore the complete[fire, life-safety and security integrators integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/fire-life-safety-security-integrators) for the systems and processes around this guide.
